verdict.notes: File decoded with latin-1 but contains Japanese multi-byte characters (EUC-JP or Shift-JIS) in comments, causing mojibake in the latin-1 rendering. This is the JMA ORCA (Japan Medical Association standard receipt software) project, a well-known open-source Japanese medical billing system. The program ID ORCR0961 and copyright notice confirm this. The COPY includes reference copybooks (.INC files) that are not shown but are standard ORCA library members.
